plugin.sysinfo.settingsPage.控制指标在状态栏中如何分列排列: Control how metrics are arranged into columns on the bar
plugin.sysinfo.settingsPage.超出后会从右侧开始新的一列: Extra items start a new column on the right
plugin.sysinfo.settingsPage.拖动手柄表示顺序；也可以用上下按钮微调。留空颜色将跟随主题。: Drag to reorder, or use the arrow buttons. Empty colors follow the theme.
plugin.sysinfo.settingsPage.至少添加一个显示项，否则状态栏不显示任何内容: Add at least one metric or this plugin will show no content on the bar
